Well, the greatesty beauty of Jordan's chronology is that it is based on a time where we ourselves exist. I didn't realise it - not totally, having missed quite obvious hints like Elsbet and Mosk and Merk shooting "lances of fire across the sky" = nuclear weaponry - until Nynaeve in TSR remarks on a strange object in the Panarch's Palace; an encircled, three-pointed star, made of a metal that felt both dull and strong at the same time. Holy cow, I realised when reading the passage again. It's the Mercedes Benz star. 

All in all, this is the greatest proof of the potential truth of the Wheel of Time concept, legends surviving from another Age to another Age to another Age for all of eternity.

What myths are ours that stem from another Age?
